## Understanding the Liam Martin NRL Salary Demand Through Hourly Conversion

When news breaks about a player’s pay, like the **liam martin nrl salary demand**, it’s often reported as an annual figure. But for most Australian workers, pay is quoted per hour. Whether you’re negotiating a contract or just curious, converting between hourly and annual pay helps you compare offers and understand your take-home amount.

Our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool does the maths for you, but here’s how it works step by step.

### The Basic Formula: Hourly × Hours × 52

Annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52 weeks. This assumes you work the same number of hours every week, with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances. For full-time employees, the standard week is 38 hours, as set by the Fair Work Commission. That’s the figure we use in our [timesheet](/).

Example: If your hourly rate is $30.00 and you work 38 hours each week, your annual gross is $30.00 × 38 × 52 = $59,280.

### Fortnightly Pay: A Handy Check

Many employers pay fortnightly. To find your gross fortnightly pay, multiply your weekly pay by two. Using the example above, weekly pay is $1,140, so fortnightly is $2,280. This can help you budget between pay cycles.

### National Minimum Wage vs Award Rates

The Fair Work Commission sets the National Minimum Wage. From 1 July 2026, it’s $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. This applies to employees not covered by an award or agreement. Most workers, however, are covered by an award that sets higher minimum rates. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides [pay guides](/blog) with award-specific rates.

If you’re a casual employee, you’re entitled to a 25% loading on top of the minimum wage. That makes the casual minimum $33.05 per hour. Our [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) page explains how this works.

### Superannuation: Paid on Top

Employers must pay superannuation guarantee contributions on top of your ordinary earnings. The rate is 12% for 2026–27, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. Super is not deducted from your pay; it’s an extra cost for your employer. For example, on a $60,000 salary, your employer adds $7,200 to your super fund.

### Tax and the Medicare Levy

Once you have your annual gross figure, you can estimate your take-home pay. The Australian Taxation Office uses a progressive tax scale for residents in 2026–27:

- Nil on the first $18,200
- 15% on income from $18,201 to $45,000
- 30% on income from $45,001 to $135,000
- 37% on income from $135,001 to $190,000
- 45% on income above $190,000

Plus, the Medicare levy is generally 2% of your taxable income. Low-income earners may qualify for a reduction. Our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) calculator applies these rates.

### Putting It All Together: A Liam Martin Example

While the exact **liam martin nrl salary demand** isn’t publicly confirmed, let’s use a hypothetical figure to illustrate. If a player demands an hourly equivalent of $50.00 for a 38-hour week, annual gross would be $98,800. After tax and Medicare, the take-home would be roughly $74,500, plus super of $11,856 paid on top.

Remember, NRL contracts often include bonuses, allowances, and other benefits not captured by a simple hourly conversion. Our [job pay](/topics/job-pay) page discusses how to factor in extras.

### When the Formula Doesn’t Apply

- **Award/agreement-free employees** must be paid at least the National Minimum Wage.
- **Annualised salaries** under some awards may cover penalties and overtime in a fixed amount. Employers must review these arrangements every 12 months to ensure they meet award minimums.
- **Casual employees** get the 25% loading but no paid leave.

For a full breakdown of rates and rules, see our [reference tables](/data) and [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page.

### Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
